name: GM - Orion Assembly, Lake Orion MI

fieldNotes.facility: GM Orion Assembly, 4555 Giddings Rd, Lake Orion MI. The given city coords (42.7847,-83.2483) land on Lake Orion village; the plant is ~8 km south near the Brown Rd / Giddings Rd / Joslyn Rd corner. Confirmed by the unmistakable signature: a ~4M sq ft assembly building ringed by a vehicle test/proving oval, finished-vehicle marshalling lots, on-site wastewater clarifiers and a rail spur. Center locked at 42.7155,-83.2590.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced controlled-access GM campus. Chain-link perimeter fence with the plant behind a berm is directly visible in Street View on both Brown Rd (south) and the Giddings Rd frontage. Site has numbered controlled gates (Waze lists Gate 3 and Gate 4); a temporary truck entrance is currently on Brown Rd during the ongoing expansion construction.
fieldNotes.guardShack: GM assembly plants operate staffed security gatehouses at controlled entries; standard for the campus and consistent with the fenced perimeter and numbered gates. Booth-scale structures sit at the entry drives.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because guard shack present (staffed gates).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Campus security plus a separate finished-vehicle shipping yard imply staged checkpoints: outer plant gate, then internal marshalling/shipping control before docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple numbered gates around the ring road give distinct entry/exit points rather than one shared lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Material-receiving docks are distributed across multiple building faces of the very large assembly building plus a south truck-terminal dock building and a covered rail receiving structure; total well exceeds 50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved finished-vehicle marshalling yard SE of the plant (hundreds of finished units in rows) plus trailer staging at the truck terminal; functions as on-site drop/storage.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active single-track rail spur curves into the property from the NE to a covered rail receiving / auto-rack structure; clearly visible in imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main assembly building, south truck terminal, paint/utility buildings, wastewater treatment plant, battery/expansion buildings under construction to the north, and rail dock.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial set among woods, wetlands and a lake with low-density residential nearby; classified Rural per rubric (small-town/edge-of-town setting).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in overhead imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.streetView: Best driver-arrival pano is on the Giddings Rd frontage at ~42.7187,-83.2689 (captured 2025-06), showing the perimeter fence and plant; pano_id not embedded here, headings computed toward zone centroids.
fieldNotes.construction: Site is mid-expansion (GM retooling Orion for EV/ICE truck and Cadillac Escalade production ~2027); northern parcels show active grading. Gate locations may shift as construction completes.

citations.claim: Orion Assembly is currently idle; inactive since the Chevrolet Bolt ended in 2023; $4B retooling on track to complete ~mid-2026 with no vehicle production resumed yet
GM repeatedly delayed restart of Orion Assembly; plant not in production during retooling

verification.rationale: REJECT per protocol: Orion Assembly is idled / ceased production (no output since the 2023 Bolt wind-down; still mid-retool as of Feb 2026). Current-ops audit excludes idled sites. GM still owns it (retained by New GM in 2009, not divested), but it is not currently operating.
